description: Communications at system and network boundaries are not monitored or controlled. This signal indicates that traffic entering or leaving security domains is not subject to inspection, filtering, or access controls.
applicability: Applicable to network perimeters, cloud VPC boundaries, security zones, and any demarcation point between trust levels. Includes firewalls, network ACLs, security groups, and web application firewalls.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through network architecture review, firewall and security group analysis, traffic flow inspection, and network segmentation assessment.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
